sigma_console_login_outside_known_ranges.alarm_query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter (((ispresent(eventName) and eventName like /(?is)^ConsoleLogin$/) and (ispresent(responseElements.ConsoleLogin) and responseElements.ConsoleLogin like /(?is)^Success$/)) and (not ((ispresent(sourceIPAddress) and isIpInSubnet(sourceIPAddress, "192.0.2.0/24")) or (ispresent(sourceIPAddress) and isIpInSubnet(sourceIPAddress, "2001:db8::/32")))))
sigma_console_login_outside_known_ranges.saved_query:
fields @timestamp, eventSource, eventName, errorCode, awsRegion, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.principalId
| filter (((ispresent(eventName) and eventName like /(?is)^ConsoleLogin$/) and (ispresent(responseElements.ConsoleLogin) and responseElements.ConsoleLogin like /(?is)^Success$/)) and (not ((ispresent(sourceIPAddress) and isIpInSubnet(sourceIPAddress, "192.0.2.0/24")) or (ispresent(sourceIPAddress) and isIpInSubnet(sourceIPAddress, "2001:db8::/32")))))
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500
sigma_console_login_outside_known_ranges.title: Console Sign-In From Outside Known Ranges
